classification.difficultyReason: Find both intercepts by substitution and linear equation solving, then translate each pair into a straight-line sketch. The preceding question explicitly supplies the method.

content.prompt: Use a similar technique to Question 5 to sketch the following linear functions.

answer.worked:
For the $x$-intercept, set $y=0$.
$$\begin{align*}2x+1&=0\\2x&=-1\\x&=-\frac12\end{align*}$$
For the $y$-intercept, set $x=0$: $y=1$. Plot $(-\frac12,0)$ and $(0,1)$, then draw the straight line through them.

answer.worked:
For the $x$-intercept, set $y=0$.
$$\begin{align*}0.5x-1&=0\\0.5x&=1\\x&=2\end{align*}$$
For the $y$-intercept, set $x=0$: $y=-1$. Plot $(2,0)$ and $(0,-1)$, then draw the straight line through them.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3(b); answer PDF page 14, printed page 308
spec.description: Increasing line through labelled intercepts 2 and -1.

answer.worked:
For the $x$-intercept, set $y=0$.
$$\begin{align*}2-4x&=0\\4x&=2\\x&=\frac12\end{align*}$$
For the $y$-intercept, set $x=0$: $y=2$. Plot $(\frac12,0)$ and $(0,2)$, then draw the straight line through them.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3(c); answer PDF page 14, printed page 308
spec.description: Decreasing line through labelled intercepts 1/2 and 2.

answer.worked:
For the $x$-intercept, set $y=0$.
$$\begin{align*}-2x-3&=0\\-2x&=3\\x&=-\frac32\end{align*}$$
For the $y$-intercept, set $x=0$: $y=-3$. Plot $(-\frac32,0)$ and $(0,-3)$, then draw the straight line through them.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3(d); answer PDF page 14, printed page 308
spec.description: Decreasing line through labelled intercepts -3/2 and -3.

answer.worked:
For the $x$-intercept, set $y=0$.
$$\begin{align*}3x-1&=0\\3x&=1\\x&=\frac13\end{align*}$$
For the $y$-intercept, set $x=0$.
$$\begin{align*}2y-1&=0\\2y&=1\\y&=\frac12\end{align*}$$
Plot $(\frac13,0)$ and $(0,\frac12)$, then draw the straight line through them.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3(e); answer PDF page 14, printed page 308
spec.description: Decreasing line through labelled intercepts 1/3 and 1/2.

answer.worked:
For the $x$-intercept, set $y=0$.
$$\begin{align*}5x+3&=0\\5x&=-3\\x&=-\frac35\end{align*}$$
For the $y$-intercept, set $x=0$.
$$\begin{align*}-4y+3&=0\\-4y&=-3\\y&=\frac34\end{align*}$$
Plot $(-\frac35,0)$ and $(0,\frac34)$, then draw the straight line through them.
